decision_definitions.reuse: Adopt the upstream contract without semantic changes.
decision_definitions.adapt: Preserve the upstream contract while replacing environment-specific execution or state.
decision_definitions.supersede: Do not activate upstream behavior; the named local contract is authoritative.

components.reason: Document cross-checking and fact grounding are strong, but interactive markdown profiles cannot be the private SSOT.
components.local_contract: Write only verified facts into the private profile and fact ledger.

components.reason: Search-query and dedupe semantics transfer, while sources and durable state must support Japan and global roles.
components.local_contract: Use official-source discovery and ledger-backed canonical posting identity.

components.reason: The honest scoring and veto flow transfers, but compensation, location, travel, and clearance policy are local.
components.local_contract: Keep grounded dimensions and fail-closed vetoes under the versioned Dais strategy.

components.reason: Research, drafting, review, and ATS checks transfer, but upstream stops before autonomous receipt-fenced submission.
components.local_contract: Generate grounded artifacts and submit through the sole CloakBrowser owner with authoritative receipts.

components.reason: Outcome, follow-up, and exact-artifact archival semantics transfer, while CSV and markdown cannot be authoritative state.
components.local_contract: Append authoritative outcomes and follow-ups to the immutable event ledger.

components.reason: Message taxonomy transfers, but approval batches must become deterministic gog checkpoints and safe automatic transitions.
components.local_contract: Key every message by immutable Gmail ID and fail closed on ambiguous application matching.

components.reason: Preparation from exact submitted evidence transfers, while Calendar, Telegram, and debrief automation are local.
components.local_contract: Trigger preparation only from verified progression and preserve Calendar and debrief receipts.

components.reason: Gap aggregation transfers, but inferred gaps cannot mutate profile truth or strategy without experiment gates.
components.local_contract: Project verified gaps from ledger cohorts and keep learning recommendations non-authoritative.

components.reason: The dashboard information design transfers, but its files cannot become a second source of truth.
components.local_contract: Render reporting surfaces only from event-ledger projections.

components.reason: One-way idempotent projection is safe, but Notion is optional and never authoritative.
components.local_contract: Allow read-only ledger projection after local completion without syncing private document content.

components.local_contract: Import Dais manual LinkedIn discoveries and use authorized official job sources.

components.reason: The adapter checklist transfers, but every source needs policy, provenance, timeout, and receipt tests.
components.local_contract: Register only authorized official-source adapters with deterministic normalization tests.

components.reason: Adding a grounded presentation template does not change candidate facts or authoritative state.
components.local_contract: Templates may change layout and emphasis but never introduce unverified claims.

components.reason: Search expansion transfers, but it must respond to quota deficits without weakening hard gates.
components.local_contract: Expand sources, queries, and adjacent segments under unchanged eligibility policy.

components.reason: Destructive interactive reset conflicts with append-only evidence and rebuildable projections.
components.local_contract: Never erase ledger evidence; reset only derived projections through deterministic rebuild.

components.reason: The Denmark-oriented salary workbook does not implement the JPY and timestamped BOJ contract.
components.local_contract: Use authoritative job compensation and timestamped BOJ conversion evidence.

components.reason: The MIT-licensed typography and LaTeX presentation assets are reusable with attribution preserved.
components.local_contract: Use only as presentation assets after ATS extraction and visual verification.

components.reason: Prompt-injection and secret-handling guards strengthen the same fail-closed boundary.
components.local_contract: Retain or strengthen every guard and prove parity with local adversarial tests.

components.reason: Update detection transfers, but activation requires the pinned provenance and adoption review gates.
components.local_contract: Report new tags without automatically changing the active upstream lock.

components.reason: Behavioral tests are reusable evidence, but paths and runtime bindings differ locally.
components.local_contract: Port relevant tests beside each adopted contract and keep the local suite authoritative.

components.reason: Documentation provides provenance and upstream operating intent without becoming runtime state.
components.local_contract: Use as cited reference; this Job Hunter spec remains the local product SSOT.

components.reason: Claude interactive runtime wiring cannot own the resident Luna/Terra loop or external side effects.
components.local_contract: Use the local runner, model route map, launchd services, ledger, and CloakBrowser owner.
